data.name: Nimbus of Light
data.description: You can emit a 30-foot nimbus of light for %1 rounds per day. This acts as a Daylight spell. In addition, undead within this radius take %1 points of damage each round that they remain inside the nimbus. Spells and spell-like abilities with the Darkness descriptor are automatically dispelled if brought inside this nimbus. These rounds do not need to be consecutive.|SunNimbusOfLightRounds
